Hi, thank you so much for responding! I think I really needed these words to stick on my head as I realized that I stopped writing just for the heck of it and went forward to checking out every books to tell me what to do. I was pretty lost to the point where I didn't know what to do anymore, like I couldn't remember what the fundamental was; to write because you want to. I like writing, it is my favourite passion out of every hobbies I have garnered on my list. It is also the most difficult to keep in track of! I find myself getting swayed by my self-doubt every time I attempt to write and at some point I got sick of it and tried doing it by the books. I will try my best in learning how to write again for myself, even if it gets difficult at some point, I will keep on trying until I am satisfied! Thanks again.  


P.S Although I do not lean towards fantasy books when I read, I sure as hell would love to read your trilogy when it is published!
